source: Mirrors the numbered actionable todos in ROADMAP.md (root) - keep both in step.
order: Pane order is computed, not numeric: topological by deps, then priority, then cost, then n.
state: Milestone 2 (2026-10-22): fleet correctness + a simulation bench. 9 open, 23 cost points. Entries are scope sketches; each item gets its own spec session when called. Release 1 closed 2026-10-21; 55 closed 2026-10-22; 56 and 63 closed 2026-10-24 (deps still name the closed ids on purpose - the pane treats an unknown dep as satisfied).

features.title: Super-fast sim session (10-50x) so a test round is not a coffee break
Sim boats with variance and faults: missed gate, OCS, RET, DNF, DSQ
Competitor names on entries (a table of MAC addresses is unreadable)
Provisional standings while the race is running (rank by progress)
Device POS readout on the race screen (former todo 54)
Multi-boat replay: interleaved cursors and per-boat splits
OCS from a single-fix straddle: needs hysteresis, not one sample
Repeat a practice session and compare it live with the previous one (device-driven)
A protest raised from the device (filing only, no standings change)
